3. Kite(a,d,c,g) & Length_a_d - Length_c_d & -Length_a_g + Length_c_g => Angle_a_g_d - Angle_c_g_d

9. Length_a_g - Length_b_g & Length_a_g - Length_c_g & Angle_a_c_b + Angle_b_a_d - pi => Perpendicular(a,d,a,g)
10. Length_a_g - Length_c_g & Length_a_g - Length_b_g & Perpendicular(a,d,a,g) => -Angle_a_b_c + Angle_c_a_d
11. Angle_a_d_g + Angle_a_g_d + Angle_d_a_g - pi & Angle_a_g_d - Angle_c_g_d & Angle_a_d_g + Angle_c_a_d - pi/2 & Angle_d_a_g - pi/2 & -Angle_a_b_c + Angle_c_a_d => Angle_a_b_c - Angle_c_g_d
12. Perpendicular(a,b,a,c) & Perpendicular(a,c,d,g) => Parallel(a,b,d,g)
13. Angle_a_b_c - Angle_c_g_d & Parallel(a,b,d,g) => Parallel(b,c,c,g)
